answer: Farming becomes a comet bet on surviving 55 epochs of grading, and every pearl settlement recomputes the quartz schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 55 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
